description: Canonical openOM finding-code registry (#151): code -> requirement back-reference + severity. Single source both cores drift-lock to (validate.py _REQUIREMENT / consistency.ts REQUIREMENT). Adding a code means editing here + both maps; the drift tests fail if they diverge.

OMI-I001.message: currency member absent; the payload is interpreted as USD

OMI-I002.message: rentPeriod source omitted; provenance defaults to 'asserted'

OMI-I003.message: advisory context for a skipped or non-applicable consistency check

OMV-E001.message: payload does not conform to the openOM 0.1 JSON Schema

OMV-E002.message: noiType and noiAsOfDate are required when deal.noi is present

OMV-E003.message: meta.signature is neither null nor the reserved {alg,keyId,value} shape

OMV-E010.message: meta.supersedes is not a 'sha256:'<64-hex> string or null

OMV-E011.message: integer value exceeds the ECMAScript safe range (2^53-1); embed would reject it

OMW-W010.message: capRate disagrees with noi / askingPrice beyond tolerance

OMW-W011.message: pricePerSF disagrees with askingPrice / buildingSF beyond tolerance

OMW-W012.message: pro-forma NOI given without a noiAsOfDate

OMW-W013.message: capRate falls outside the plausibility band

OMW-W014.message: a monetary or area value is present but non-positive

OMW-W020.message: year-1 scheduled rent disagrees with the stated in-place NOI

OMW-W021.message: a gap exists between consecutive rent-schedule periods

OMW-W023.message: escalationFromPrior disagrees with the actual rent step

OMW-W026.message: a rent period falls outside the lease term

OMW-W030.message: remaining lease term disagrees with the term dates

OMW-W031.message: total lease term disagrees with the term dates

OMW-W032.message: assertedDate is in the future relative to the processing date

OMW-W034.message: lease expiration is on or before its commencement

OMW-W040.message: a net-lease type is stated but pass-throughs are missing/inconsistent

OMW-W041.message: stated lease type disagrees with the expense responsibilities

OMW-W050.message: meta.supersedes equals this payload's own hash (self-supersede no-op)

OMW-W060.message: a source claims 'verified' that the tooling cannot verify

OMW-W061.message: currency absent; USD assumed (paired with OMI-I001)

OMW-W051.message: a same-domain mirror carries a newer, superseding assertion (stale)

OMW-W052.message: a same-domain mirror shows different, non-superseding content (diverged)
